pages.text: The Large Pocket Generator extends JDT's pocket generator with $(bold)4x$() internal FE capacity while keeping its fuel slot, toggle state, and generation behavior.$(br2)$(bold)Features$()$(br2)$(li)Equips in the dedicated Curios $(thing)large_pocket_generator$() slot.$(li)Opens through its dedicated hotkey.$(li)Continues charging compatible items in both inventory and Curios using JDT's existing charging behavior.$(li)Uses the resolved large fuel canister burn multiplier when one is inserted as fuel.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting$()
